title: Add manual-Admin lifecycle state model and projection guards
verify: The logical state union covers pending_payment, paid, processing, completed, canceled, and refunded; expired normalizes to canceled with timeout reason.
Native Medusa status/payment/fulfillment evidence maps deterministically to the logical projection without trusting Store input.

Allowed transitions and forbidden transitions match the FT-008 state spec: Admin may mark an unpaid order paid, and native Admin cancellation may project pending/paid/processing orders as canceled when native preconditions allow it.

An order_canceled or cancellation-origin payment_refunded event with checkout_expiry_origin ft-007 preserves checkout_state expired, timeout reason, and pending/complete cleanup state; compatible existing FT-007 expired records without the new marker are also preserved.

A cancellation-origin payment_refunded event keeps a canceled order in canceled; partial standalone refunds preserve the current logical state, and only persisted native refunds (or authoritative raw_refunded_amount) covering all persisted native captures (or raw_captured_amount) within native currency precision project a non-canceled paid/processing/completed order to refunded; no capture/refund status field is assumed.
Repeated events targeting the current state are safe no-ops and contradictory events leave the source order state unchanged.
Unknown event kinds and caller-supplied source, actor, status, payment, or target-metadata values are rejected before any lifecycle write.
The helper preserves all FT-007 metadata, never claims that notification delivery proves commit or serialization, and does not add a custom order, Admin, payment, or inventory store.

verify.reason: All TASK-054 functional acceptance criteria, required T2 gates, supplemental transition/refund matrix, and scope/anti-goal checks passed.
verify.operator_basis: User explicitly requested closure of TASK-054 in standalone manual mode after functional verification PASS.

verify.reason: TASK-054 satisfies T2 manual closure requirements: full protocol, required packet/spec gates, functional PASS, and explicit standalone closure ownership.

evidence_required: Deterministic transition/projection matrix output for all allowed and forbidden states.

Expired-to-canceled normalization, FT-007 expiry-origin/cleanup preservation (including legacy expired compatibility), duplicate/no-op, payment/order disagreement, and reservation-preservation assertions.

Refund assertions cover cancellation origin, one partial refund, cumulative intermediate refunds, the final full refund, duplicate/out-of-order notifications, both cancellation event orders, and no premature or canceled-state overwrite.
Unknown-event and caller-supplied source/actor/status/payment/metadata rejection output with no lifecycle mutation.
Backend typecheck/build and Memory Bank lint output.
constraints: Use pure/backend-owned projection and guards over native Medusa state; do not modify Medusa Core.

Treat FT-007 expired as global canceled with a timeout reason while preserving checkout_state expired, checkout_expiry_origin ft-007, expiry reason, pending/complete cleanup, and all existing metadata keys.
Model native events only as server-internal projection notifications; pre-native serialization belongs to TASK-055 and must not be falsely inferred from event arrival.
The current payment profile is personal/offline: only the native Admin payment action may produce paid; do not call a provider or expose a Store lifecycle mutation route.
Do not delete reservations or mutate stock quantities.
invariants: Expired, canceled, and refunded orders cannot re-enter paid or processing.
FT-007-origin cancellation/refund evidence cannot overwrite checkout_state expired or hide pending reservation cleanup.

A cancellation-origin or partial refund cannot overwrite the logical state with refunded; standalone refunded requires a non-canceled paid/processing/completed order and the authoritative cumulative full-refund predicate.
A canceled order cannot re-enter paid or processing; native cancellation remains persisted and does not restore the active cart.
Projection is deterministic from authoritative native records and logical metadata.
Duplicate current-state events produce no second transition or side effect.
purpose: Establish the executable lifecycle vocabulary and guard matrix before cross-module transition work.
success_outcome: A deterministic backend projection and guard helper proves the complete FT-008 state machine without adding a second source of truth.
anti_goals: Do not implement provider webhooks, online payment creation, Admin UI, email delivery, or inventory mutation.
Do not create a custom lifecycle database or replace native Medusa statuses.

forbidden_scope: Admin UI or custom order API
reservation deletion, direct stock mutation, production data, secrets
stop_conditions: Installed Medusa native status/payment/fulfillment fields cannot support a truthful projection.
The transition matrix conflicts with the linked FT-008 state spec or FT-007 expiry contract.
The pure model cannot distinguish FT-007 expiry-origin cancellation from operator cancellation without discarding cleanup state.
Authoritative native capture/refund totals or currency precision cannot support a deterministic cumulative full-refund predicate.
Verification cannot distinguish a no-op from a real duplicate side effect.
